interpretation: Container memory.swap.max=0 constrains Linux cgroup swap; it does not prevent macOS from swapping or compressing memory backing the Linux VM.
These counters cover the entire macOS host, not specifically this container or VM. This observation alone neither attributes the host pressure to logging02 nor explains the stream failure.
Zero Linux VM steal and zero Docker/Linux OOM counters do not establish a quiet host or exclude host paging/compression.

Before timing interpretation, retain measured macOS before/after swap, compressor occupancy and paging counter deltas for both cells, alongside Linux cgroup/phase data and clock-domain evidence. Keep pinned configurations unchanged mid-pair.
